handshake_invariants: No envelope field is synthesized from a display label.
Repeated idempotency keys may resolve existing receipts, not repeat physical execution.
Offline/cached authority never broadens a lease.
Root mismatch, revoked provider or no ACL => stay read-only.
Cross-node transfer requires distinct node IDs and exact receiver hash/size before dependent work.
Agent failure returns work to resumable queue; no mandatory synchronous handoff between scheduled cloud agents.
A heartbeat is not evidence of successful source hydration, installed tools, or native FileSpace admission.

action_profiles.user_education: Show why missing rights hold work, and one actionable remedy.
action_profiles.smart_repair: Compare receipts, source versions and capability registration; never overwrite accepted source.
action_profiles.guided_install: Select existing managed LS profile and return explicit host command after operator review; no shell here.
action_profiles.autoboot: Only enabled after opted-in host-run acceptance; no cron/watchdog generation in review.
action_profiles.network: Provider opt-in and specific source types; unrelated accounts never scanned.
